question: Will the AAA national average price of regular gasoline be below $4.05 per gallon on November 13, 2026?

calls.reasoning: AAA national average was $4.1694 on 11/2/26 (11/1: $4.1732). Getting below $4.05 by 11/13 needs ~12c over 11 days (~1.1c/day). The trailing 11-day pace was ~0.9c/day, so the trend alone reaches ~$4.07. On 11/2 crude fell ~3% on US-Iran diplomacy reports (Brent ~$110) and RBOB futures fell ~17c to $2.98, their lowest since late August. The usual 1-2 week retail lag should add several cents of extra decline if the drop holds. Some of the RBOB move may be the Nov-to-Dec contract roll. Prices fall slowly at the pump and Iran talks could collapse. No matching human market was found; the Polymarket Nov 2 range contracts only confirm $4.16-4.17 and the Manifold $4.50 market is a different question. Net: slightly above a coin flip.

calls.reasoning: AAA regular $4.1694 on 11/2/26; need ~12c drop in 11 days (~1.1c/day). Trailing trend alone lands ~$4.06-4.08. Dec RBOB itself fell 17.7c (-5.6%) to $2.979 on 11/2, a real drop and not a Nov->Dec roll artifact, leaving the pump-RBOB spread ~$1.19, wide versus a ~$0.95-1.10 norm; 1-2 week pass-through of even half the drop adds 6-9c to the slide, pointing to ~$4.00-4.06 on 11/13. Against: rockets-and-feathers stickiness, recent daily deceleration to <0.5c/day, and two-sided Iran/Hormuz crude risk with the drop only one day old.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) whether the 11/2 RBOB drop to ~$2.98 was a contract-roll artifact (factual) - Investing.com contracts page shows Dec26 RBZ26 at 2.9793, -0.1772 (-5.62%) on the day, so the drop is genuine on the same contract; this removes Run 1's caveat and strengthens the pass-through case that Runs 2/3 discounted. (2) Current AAA level (factual) - re-fetched AAA: $4.1694 as of 11/2, yesterday $4.1732, week ago $4.2858, confirming all runs. (3) Weight on recent daily deceleration vs wholesale pass-through, and spread-normalization level (judgment) - with spread ~$1.19 against a ~$1.00-1.10 norm and a confirmed 17c wholesale drop, I'd bet the pass-through drives slightly more than the needed 12c, but crude volatility and sticky retail keep it near a coin flip. Lands slightly above Run 1.
